purpose: Guard the existing ACIS 21500 parser behavior while the third SAB header word's version-specific meaning remains unresolved.

references.title: ACIS SAT File Format, SAT Format 7.0, Save File Header
references.relevantFinding: The third integer is described as a count of entities in the original entity list saved to the part file.
references.scopeLimit: This describes SAT Format 7.0, not Autodesk-modified ACIS 21500.

references.title: Working with .sat and .sab Files in Teigha
references.relevantFinding: Maps DWG R24/2010 to format 21500 and says 20800+ Autodesk SAT/SAB formats are modified from Spatial ACIS.
references.scopeLimit: The article does not define the third header word.

references.title: CADMPEG ASM and ACIS stream format specification
references.relevantFinding: Defines an entity-count boundary for explicitly admitted 217/218 streams.
references.scopeLimit: 217/218 semantics cannot be transferred to 21500 without version-specific evidence.

evidence.existingPhysicalObservation: Two hash-bound AC1024/21500 one-body payloads have raw third word 2. Their source and independent-reader evidence do not establish the field's 21500 meaning.

implementation.control: A locally generated ACIS BinaryFile 21500 stream declares recordCount=0 and raw third word 2, contains one initial body plus three additional records, and ends with the explicit terminal marker.
assertions: Parsing completes only at the explicit terminal marker.
recordCountKnown remains false for the zero record-count profile.
The raw third word is preserved as numEntities=2.
All five records including the terminal record are retained; the third word is not applied as a record limit.

claimEffect: Regression protection only. No semantic interpretation, source boundary, output eligibility, B-rep qualification, or support claim is promoted.
decision: Keep the field raw and version-specific. Require eligible 21500 producer/schema evidence, ideally a discriminating multi-root source, before semantic use.
